title: Amputation and ostomy status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM status codes this note supports.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for hypertension.

HPI: Pt is a 90 y.o. male presenting for routine follow-up of HTN. Pt reports feeling well overall. Denies any recent falls, shortness of breath, or chest pain. He notes he is using his prosthesis for mobility as usual. No new complaints today.

Medication List:
- Lisinopril 10mg QD
- Amlodipine 5mg QD
- Atorvastatin 20mg QD

Vitals:
BP: 138/82
HR: 72 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 97% on RA
Ht/Hgb: 13.2 / 12.1
eGFR: 65

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: No fever, chills, or weight change.
CV: No chest pain, palpitations, or edema.
Resp: No SOB or cough.
GI: No nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea.
MSK: No joint pain or stiffness.
Neuro: No dizziness or numbness.

Social History: Retired. Lives with wife. Non-smoker. Occasional alcohol use.

Family History: Father had HTN. Mother had stroke.

Exam:
Gen: Alert and oriented x3. Appears stated age. CTAB.
CV: RRR, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: Clear to auscultation bilaterally.
MSK: Right below-knee amputation site intact. Prosthesis in place. Good range of motion in remaining joints.
Neuro: Alert, steady gait with assistance.

Assessment:
1. Hypertension: Well-controlled on current regimen.
2. Status post right BKA: Stable.

Plan:
1. Continue current medications as prescribed.
2. Continue monitoring BP at home.
3. Return to clinic in 3 months for routine follow-up.

Electronically signed,
L. Moreau, DO
05/14/2026
explanations: Acquired absence of the right leg below the knee: Z89.511 (HCC 409). A status that still applies is coded at every visit where it is documented.
